settings.info: Shown when a link to the store is shared. 1200 x 630px works best.

settings.content: The theme is built on a near-black surface ramp. Accent is used sparingly for primary buttons and highlights so it keeps its impact.

settings.label: Text on accent
settings.info: Keep a strong contrast against the accent colour so button labels stay readable.

settings.content: Applies once to every section on the AI Receptionist page and product - the hero, the dashboard mockup, pricing and FAQ all pick this up automatically. Leave blank to keep the flat colour.

Leave the endpoint blank and the assistant answers from a built-in knowledge base. Paste your Worker URL and it answers with a real AI model instead, still quoting live store data for anything about prices, products or policies.

settings.label: AI endpoint URL
settings.info: Your deployed optiq-ai-worker URL, e.g. https://optiq-ai.yourname.workers.dev - see optiq-ai-worker/README.md for the five-minute setup. An API key must never be pasted here; the Worker holds it.
